description: Structural fx2-cmix build with a reversible MediaWiki page-topic sort candidate selected against raw fx2 output
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Uses the SIDECAR_EXTRA_MATCH cmix.bin.gz and english.dic.gz payload from fx2_structural_match_v1. Complete pages may be topic-sorted before compression; decompression restores original enwik9 order by page id.
verdict: Pruned. The selector chose raw at both 250k and 1MB, producing the raw structural-match archive plus a one-byte mode tag while paying a larger Python wrapper.
